name: time-field
title: Time Field
description: A time of day as one typed field: "HH:mm" in and out, shown on the locale's 12- or 24-hour clock, stepped by the arrow keys within min and max.

meta.whenToUse: A time of day on its own: a schedule's time, a reminder, opening hours. Typed ("930", "9:30 pm") or stepped with the arrow keys; the value is always HH:mm.
meta.whenNotToUse: A date and a time together (DateTimePicker), a duration (NumberField with a unit), or an instant across time zones.
